description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating a Food token, a Clue token, and a Treasure tokens.
The three tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil that many times, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two artifact tokens, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.
